description: Record's Settings dialog (a libadwaita preferences dialog, one scrolling page of groups). Each row takes effect at once and is kept; Code Font takes from the next start. Most rows are Baude's too, the same settings (settings.json); the ones only Record has are marked.
opens: Meta asked about a setting shows that setting's row

parts.name: Providers page
parts.shows: A Claude and a Codex account picker, with Add account for each provider. Claude also has a Subscription usage row.

parts.name: title
parts.shows: "Settings"

parts.name: group: Meta
parts.shows: A group titled "Meta", the same rows as Baude's.

parts.name: Intelligence
parts.shows: Row "Intelligence", subtitle "The model Meta thinks with", a flat model picker at the right (a search box and a list with each family's icon: Claude's models first, then every other in the mesh). Taken from Meta's next message.

actions.does: Meta thinks with it from its next message; the Provider and Effort rows follow.

parts.name: Provider
parts.shows: Row "Provider", subtitle "Where the model runs", a host picker at the right (this machine first). Greyed and off on Claude's models (claude runs where it is).

actions.does: Moves Meta's model to that provider, from its next message.

parts.name: Effort
parts.shows: A choice row "Effort", subtitle "How hard Meta thinks"; choices "Default" then the levels its model takes. Greyed with "{model} has no effort setting" when the model has none.

parts.name: Run commands
parts.shows: A switch "Run commands", subtitle "Meta runs shell commands and edits files, in Auto mode"; or "{note}: Meta asks before each command"; greyed and off with "{model} only reads: Claude's models run commands" on a model that only reads.

parts.name: Code mode
parts.shows: A switch "Code mode", subtitle "Meta acts by writing up to {n} lines of Python".

parts.name: group: general
parts.shows: An untitled group, rows in this order:

parts.name: Full-width text
parts.shows: A switch "Full-width text": the same as ☰ → Full-width text.

parts.name: Markup visibility (Record only)
parts.shows: A choice row "Markup visibility" with three choices: "Show formatting on current line" (default: the Markdown marks of a heading, bold, code, quote, list on the line the caret is on), "Don't show formatting", "Show all formatting (Except Links)". Every open page is redrawn at once.

parts.name: Code Font
parts.shows: A choice row "Code Font" listing the available code fonts. Picked other than the font in use, the subtitle says "{font} from Record's next start" and a "Restart" button appears in the row (closes the dialog, restarts Record).

parts.name: Accent Colour
parts.shows: A choice row "Accent Colour": "System" or one of libadwaita's colours, each with a dot of its colour. Taken in every window as picked, and by Record's and Baude's logos (Settings' Accent Colour).

parts.name: Auto restart on update
parts.shows: A switch "Auto restart on update", subtitle "From {upstream} every {seconds}s, restarting once idle"; greyed with "Not a git checkout following a branch: nothing to update from" when there is no upstream. Off until turned on.

parts.name: Notifications
parts.shows: A switch "Notifications", subtitle "When a reply finishes, or asks you something, while you're elsewhere". On unless turned off.

parts.name: Version
parts.shows: A plain row (no action): title "Version {commit}" (the commit this running Record's code is), subtitle the date and time it was made ("21 November 2026, 14:03"). Without a git checkout: "Version unknown" with subtitle "Not a git checkout". There is no Changelog row here: Changelog is in ☰.

parts.name: Check Spelling (Record only)
parts.shows: A switch "Check Spelling". Subtitle says what checks: "Starting…" first, then "Spelling with Enchant, grammar with Harper", or on macOS "Spelling and grammar, as macOS checks them", or what is missing ("Needs Enchant 2 and a dictionary (libenchant-2, hunspell-en-us) for spelling, harper-ls for grammar" and variants). On: a red squiggle under a misspelled word in notes and a blue one under a grammar error.

parts.name: Include glossary and chats in backup (Record only)
parts.shows: A switch "Include glossary and chats in backup", subtitle the backup file's path (~/.local/share/record/notebooks-backup.zip, with ~ for the home folder). Record rolls all its local notebooks into that one zip every 10 minutes when they changed (the zip is replaced each time); on, the glossary and chats go in it too.
text: Include glossary and chats in backup

parts.name: Show in Applications
parts.shows: A switch "Show in Applications" (macOS) or "Show in application menu" (Linux), no subtitle. The same one setting as Baude's Settings row: on when Baude, Record, Emission and Multiplex are all in the platform's list of apps, read again each time Settings opens. On: all four are added (per user), each with its logo (Baude's and Record's in the accent picked), each starting its command in ~/.local/bin, written with Baude's other commands; off: all four removed (the commands stay).

phone.why: Show in Applications installs a macOS app bundle or freedesktop launcher; a phone's launcher is the OS's own.

parts.name: group: Size
parts.shows: A group titled "Size": three number rows with steppers, 1.0 the usual, steps of 0.1: "Text Scale", "Icon Scale", "Global Scale" (what Ctrl+0 / Cmd+0 goes back to, and the zoom right now). Applied as they change; the same settings as Baude's.

parts.name: group: export
parts.shows: An untitled group of arrow rows: "Export Notebook…" (only with a notebook open; the open one) then "Export All Notebooks…". Each subtitle starts "Working out size…" and then reads "{size}, or {size} with glossary and chats" (sizes as "412 bytes", "3.4 KB", "12 MB"), or "{size}; with glossary and chats, not known", or "Size not known". Closing Settings stops working the sizes out.

parts.name: group: feedback
parts.shows: Two arrow button rows: "Send Feedback…" and "Ongoing Feedback". Each closes Settings first and then does what the ☰ item does.
